title: Spherical Time Extent
description: Spatiotemporal point coordinates in spherical space with timestamps.

time.description: Array of point timestamps in seconds.

azimuth.description: Array of azimuth angles in degrees in [-180, +180).

elevation.description: Array of elevation angles in degrees in [-90, +90].

radius.description: Array of non-negative radial distances (greater than or equal to 0).

disjoint.description: Indicates whether all spatiotemporal coordinates are unique.

exhaustive.description: Indicates whether spatiotemporal observations cover the range without missing observations.

min_time.description: Lower bound of the time extent in seconds.

max_time.description: Upper bound of the time extent in seconds.

min_azimuth.description: Lower bound of azimuth angle in degrees in [-180, +180).

max_azimuth.description: Upper bound of azimuth angle in degrees in [-180, +180).

min_elevation.description: Lower bound of elevation angle in degrees in [-90, +90].

max_elevation.description: Upper bound of elevation angle in degrees in [-90, +90].

min_radius.description: Lower bound of non-negative radial distance.

max_radius.description: Upper bound of non-negative radial distance.
